definitions.explanation: The reduction of energy use through efficient equipment and habits; the full form of the common abbreviation {省|しょう}エネ.

examples.japanese: {省|しょう}エネルギー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: We are working on energy conservation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{省|しょう}エネルギー⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: New home appliances have high energy efficiency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{省|しょう}エネルギー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The government is calling on companies to make energy-conservation efforts.

notes:
The full form of ⟦{省|しょう}エネ→省エネ：06308_shouene⟧. Composed of {省|しょう} (to economize on) + ⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧ (energy, from English).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {省|しょう}エネルギー⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: energy-conservation measures
- {省|しょう}エネルギー⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧: energy-saving equipment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{省|しょう}エネ→省エネ：06308_shouene⟧: the everyday shortened form, far more common in speech
- ⟦{節電|せつでん}→節電：07136_setsuden⟧: saving electricity specifically — narrower than energy in general
